items.docs: Get the events in the signed-in user's default calendar or from a specified calendar. The list contains single instance meetings and series masters. To get expanded event instances, you can get the calendar view or the instances of an event. Requires Calendars.Read or Calendars.ReadWrite permission.

Create an event in the signed-in user's default calendar or a specified calendar. By default, the allowNewTimeProposals property is set to true when an event is created. Requires Calendars.ReadWrite permission.
